$comment: SHARED, CANONICAL parity fixture for spec 15 (SAM Page Look-and-Feel), task 13.2.
It pins the React/TS Layer-2 generator (renderPageStyles, pageStyles.ts) to the
sam/shared/page_styles/__init__.py) so a drift in EITHER implementation is caught on
The `expected` cssVariables/pageCss/fontLinks were GENERATED FROM the Python generator
and are therefore authoritative. ONE file is canonical:
sam/tests/fixtures/page_styles_parity.json. The frontend test root carries a
a guard test on EACH plane asserts the two copies are byte-for-byte identical.
Each plane feeds every case's `input` to its REAL generator and asserts the produced
cssVariables/pageCss/fontLinks equal the case's `expected` block below.
Change-with-tests: if the Python generator intentionally changes output, REGENERATE
this fixture in the SAME change (sam.tests.test_page_styles_parity.write_fixtures) and
mirror the EXACT bytes to the frontend copy; do NOT weaken either plane's assertion to

cases.name: all_defaults_empty
cases.description: All-defaults: empty settings -> every attribute resolves to its SAM-owned default (system fonts, professional colours, normal/rounded/subtle).

cases.name: full_seven_custom
cases.description: Full seven custom values: every supported attribute supplied a distinct non-default value, with web fonts so font_links are emitted.

expected.fontLinks:
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;600;700&family=Lora:wght@400;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

cases.name: partial_colours_only
cases.description: Partial subset: only the two brand colours supplied; the other five fall back to defaults.

cases.name: partial_fonts_mixed
cases.description: Partial subset: a web heading font + a system body font (two fonts, one web one system) with a compact/sharp enum mix; colours + shadow default.

expected.fontLinks:
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Open+Sans:wght@400;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

cases.name: partial_enums_only
cases.description: Partial subset: only the three enum attributes supplied (no colours, no fonts); fonts + colours default.

cases.name: sanitiser_dangerous_values
cases.description: Sanitiser exercise: a brand colour carrying url(...) and a font family carrying expression(...)/javascript: — all dangerous patterns stripped before reaching CSS.

expected.fontLinks:
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;600;700&family=expression(x)Evil:wght@400;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
